newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila in 1.0 bln peso asset sale in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Manila in 1.0 bln peso asset sale in Jan-Oct.

text.p: The Philippines has earned 1.009 billion pesos from the sale of state-owned assets in the first ten months of the year, the Assets Privatisation Trust (APT) said on Thursday.
The APT sold 3.4 billion pesos worth of assets in 1995, and 5.3 billion pesos in 1994.
Since the beginning of the privatisation programme, the government had raised 31.3 billion pesos but funds thus raised are forecast to decline in coming years.
A World Bank report said the country should strengthen its tax collection efforts to maintain budget surpluses being registered since two years ago.
